name: Furry Fatale
source:
The story happens in the span of one night in a small town when an answer to an emergency call goes awry upon meeting with three furry girls in distress. What follows is a night of lustful but fatal games.

[From [url=https://infamy999.itch.io/furry-fatale-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事发生在一个小镇的一个晚上，在遇到三个遇险的毛茸茸的女孩时，接到紧急电话却出现了问题。接下来是一个充满欲望但致命的游戏的夜晚。

[来自[url=https://infamy999.itch.io/furry-fatale-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
